settings.title: Settings

proxyAuth.title: Proxy credentials
proxyAuth.note: Used by every local proxy port.

basePort.label: Base port
basePort.note: First proxy port. Each new location gets the next free port after this one.
basePort.invalid: Enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.

lanSharing.label: Share on the local network
lanSharing.warning: Anyone on your network could reach these proxy ports. Proxy credentials become mandatory when this is on.
lanSharing.firewallNote: Windows may ask you to allow this once.
lanSharing.offNote: Off: ports only accept connections from this computer (127.0.0.1).

keepAwake.label: Keep this computer awake while ports are on
keepAwake.note: Only while at least one port is on.

giveUpAfter.label: Give up retrying after
giveUpAfter.invalid: Enter a whole number of minutes ({{min}} or more).

webhook.title: Rotate webhook
webhook.offByDefaultNote: Off by default. Opens a separate local listener only when enabled.
webhook.portInvalid: Enter a whole port number between {{min}} and {{max}}.

settings.subtitle: Changes are saved as you make them.
settings.lanSharingRequiresAuth: LAN sharing needs a proxy username and password.
settings.webhookBearerTooShort: The webhook key must be at least 16 characters.

update.title: Updates
update.autoCheckNote: Checks on start and once a day. Updates install only when you choose.
